verdict.rationale: pnpm docs state that it switches to frozen-lockfile mode automatically when it detects CI, and that installation fails in CI if the lockfile is present but needs an update. Docs also refer to 'frozen installs' validating the lockfile, so the core enforcement-and-fail behavior is documented. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented flag or setting to force frozen mode outside CI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the failure behavior.
